name: W Miami
positioning: A Brickell hotel in Miami's financial district, with floor-to-ceiling bay and skyline views, Hollywood Regency-inspired rooms and a rooftop restaurant over Biscayne Bay
best_for: Travelers who want a stylish base in Brickell with views of Biscayne Bay and the downtown skyline

facts.text: The hotel offers easy access to South Beach, PortMiami and Kaseya Center.
The hotel has views of the Miami River and the downtown skyline.
Rooms have the Signature W Hotel Bed.
Guests have access to the Icon Brickell pool, spa and fitness center, which are operated independently from the hotel.
W Miami is part of the Icon Brickell complex, which includes residences and the restaurants Cipriani and Cantina La Viente.
W Miami is pet-friendly through its Pets Are Welcome (P.A.W.) program.
TULUM Rooftop Bar & Restaurant serves local and global flavors with panoramic views of Biscayne Bay.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows, select private balconies and marble bathrooms with signature W amenities.

highlights.text: W Miami is in the heart of Brickell, Miami's financial district.
Rooms have contemporary Hollywood Regency-inspired interiors and views of downtown Miami and Biscayne Bay.
The two-bedroom Penthouse Suite has contemporary interiors and views of Miami.
Icon Brickell Spa offers massages, advanced facials, body treatments and nail services, with marine-based skincare.

considerations.text: The pool, spa and fitness center belong to the Icon Brickell complex and are operated independently from the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a beach resort atmosphere.
